compatibility.detail: Agent cards gain optional live_model (null when the session reported no model); older clients ignore the unknown field. No wire or stored-format change: the claim registry digest is unchanged, and a new operational.failure condition is read by existing fault projections.

manual.detail: Read the live model with fractal agents show <agent> --json (.live_model) or the client-v0 agent detail. The drift fault shows in fractal now and the agent's faults until usage returns to the declared model.

recovery.detail: Drift faults are durable operational.failure / operational.recovered claims on the seat, not read-side state. After a binary rollback the older build never recovers a pending model-drift/<agent> episode, so an open drift fault stays visible for that incarnation until the seat's next incarnation; nothing else needs undoing.

replay.detail: No replay change: usage claims fold as before, and the drift episodes are ordinary replicated operational.failure / operational.recovered claims folded by the existing fault projections.

rules.detail: The reconciler raises a non-blocking per-seat operational failure (condition harness-model-drift, title 'Seat runs on a fallback model') when the model the seat's own session last reported for the current incarnation (harness.usage context_occupancy or session_cumulative) differs from the declared harness model. Response spend never counts, since it includes subagents' responses under their own models; a driver whose session reports no model (Codex) gets no live model and no drift fault. Models compare after provider/variant/date normalization; a Claude alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) matches its family's API IDs, and a declaration that is neither an alias nor a priced API ID raises nothing. The seat keeps running: no stop, park, or crash loop. When the live model moves to another undeclared model while drifted, the episode is recovered and re-raised naming the new model with the original since. The fault recovers when usage returns to the declared model or the declaration adopts the live model.

schema.detail: No SQL migration. New bounded read Store::latest_usage_model (held local readings, then at most 64 newest harness.usage claims through the subject/kind/accepted index, session readings only). New operational.failure condition harness-model-drift with a [drift-since-ms] reason marker.

summary: Seats that silently fall back to another model are now observable: the reconciler raises a non-blocking per-seat drift fault naming declared vs live model and since when, and agent cards expose live_model next to the declared model.
